properties.displayName: Deny Intel VM SKUs where an AMD equivalent exists in the region
properties.description: Blocks creation of Intel virtual machines and scale sets only where AMD CCA confirms an AMD EPYC equivalent is available in that same region. Intel SKUs with no AMD counterpart, and regions where AMD is not offered, are not affected. ARM SKUs are not affected. Existing VMs continue to run. Derived from AMD CCA on 2026-10-21.

metadata.description: Audit first, then switch to Deny.
